name: webgram-theme
description: Build tooling for Webgram Theme. Compiled output ships in assets/css and assets/js; src is not shipped.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:rtl
scripts.build:js: esbuild assets/src/js/main.js assets/src/js/shop.js assets/src/js/product.js assets/src/js/cart.js assets/src/js/checkout.js assets/src/js/blocks.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2018 --outdir=assets/js
scripts.watch: npm run build:css -- --watch & npm run build:js -- --watch
scripts.build:rtl: for f in main woocommerce shop product cart-checkout; do rtlcss assets/css/$f.css assets/css/$f-rtl.css; done
